response.original_title: Love is a Dog from Hell
response.overview: Ravacana and Friends presents the short film "Love is a Dog from Hell" (2024), written and directed by Rarai Masae Soca W.A., produced by Fadhil Senopary, and presented by Studio Nyala. "Love is a Dog from Hell" (2024) tells the story of a young woman named Asha, who loves poetry and falls in love with a theater actor. Day by day, she becomes more convinced that love exists and is eternal. Through love, Asha grows and ultimately discovers herself.
